label: Mode of being: dependence reading versus constitutive reading
resolution: MODE_OF_BEING_1 (DependenceMode) reads 'r is a mode of x's being' as 'x has r in act and has being'; MODE_OF_BEING_2 (DEF-MODE-OF-BEING) is the constitutive reading, r as one of the ways in which x has being, a determination of its act of being. The registered premise 791fa216 uses the primitive ModeOfBeing, which is MODE_OF_BEING_2 by its definition record; DEF-MODE-OF-BEING's lean_declaration names the constraining premise PerfectionsAreModesOfBeing, not a declaration of the parameter (recorded gap). On MODE_OF_BEING_1 the premise follows from 7067553d and the whole transfer load sits on 2f6b9eff (dependenceReading); on MODE_OF_BEING_2 the premise carries the content of the act-of-being thesis. No statement relates the two senses; the q.4 a.1 ad 3 'unde' inference from the dependence ground to the act thesis is the open bridge (docs/notes/mode-of-being-subsistent-esse.md).
